title: Text auf Bild / tonal-support layers
slide_intent: Inspect the tonal support separately so the designer understands what makes overlaid text readable.
strategic_value: A restrained overlay can support DB headlines without introducing an unrelated panel style.
demonstration: The three sliders are moved to expose the tonal-support artwork: local darkening, a dark gradient and a light gradient with text and identity elements.
practical_value: Compare the shape and strength of each support layer before evaluating it on a photograph.

content_islands.spec: Stack the three exposed overlay states beneath their option headings, preserving the text and brand marks.
